name: Stormbringer: Kinetic Energy stacks when Torrential Wrath or Deluge is cast (#3636)
contract: Kinetic Energy 806409 reads 'Casting Torrential Wrath or Deluge now grants you a stack of Kinetic Energy.' Its single effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with TriggerSpell 806410 and TargetA 1 (caster); the buff 806410 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT with EffectBasePoints 1 + EffectDieSides 1 = 2, StackAmount 3 and DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, and aura 290 is handled natively (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct, read back through Player::UpdateSpellCritChance). Spell.dbc gives 806409 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it ('Skip if no proc flags in DBC') and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: nothing ever cast 806410. The aura-42 effect also carries EffectSpellClassMask 0/0/0, so the 'Torrential Wrath or Deluge' restriction only exists once a spell_proc row supplies SpellFamilyName 22 with SpellFamilyMask1 0x8001 (Torrential Wrath bit 0, Deluge bit 15). Expected amounts are read from 806410's own fields: 2 per stack, 2 x 3 = 6 at the cap of 3 stacks, because AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies by the stack amount. Torrential Wrath 804017 has CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms, which is why each cast is given a 3500 ms window; it also carries CasterAuraSpell 573249 ('At Least 40 Static'), one of the ResourceThresholdRules in AscensionCustomResourceData.h ({16, 803102, 40, 573249}) that AscensionCompat::SynchronizeThresholdResources applies whenever the caster holds at least 40 stacks of Static (803102), so the fixture sets Static to 100 before the first cast (Spell::CheckCast, Spell.cpp:5858, otherwise returns SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE); Torrential Wrath itself has no ResourceConsumption rule and does not spend Static. Deluge 806400 is instant, ground targeted (TargetA 16), costs 50 Static (AscensionCustomResourceData.h) and requires its own CasterAuraSpell 707050 ('At Least 50 Static'), already covered by the same Static fixture reapplied before its cast; Stormflow 567555 is family 22 with SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10000, outside the mask, and is the negative control.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Kinetic Energy passive is active
BASELINE: no Kinetic Energy buff before any cast
SETUP: the first Torrential Wrath cast was accepted
DISCRIMINATING: casting Torrential Wrath grants Kinetic Energy 806410
DISCRIMINATING: one cast is one stack
One stack is the DBC value of +2% critical strike chance
DISCRIMINATING: the player's spell critical chance rises by 2
DISCRIMINATING: a second cast is a second stack
DISCRIMINATING: a third cast reaches the DBC StackAmount of 3
Three stacks amount to 3 x 2 = 6 percentage points
DISCRIMINATING: the player's spell critical chance rises by 6
A fourth cast stays at the cap of 3 stacks
SETUP: the buff expires on its own 12 sec after the last cast
SETUP: the Deluge cast was accepted
DISCRIMINATING: casting Deluge also grants a stack (family mask bit 15)
Let the global cooldown from Deluge run out
SETUP: the Stormflow control cast was accepted
CONTROL: Stormflow is family 22 but outside the mask and grants nothing
